name: 201. Ollama decisions (ollama-decisions)
description:
The ollama provider serves local System One decision models (nimble, tev1, clef, clef-flash, laya) natively on POST {key url}/v1/systemone, in Typesafe's systemone shape plus Ollama's top-level images and keep_alive. Questions and state go through Typesafe's converter; keep_alive (a duration string or a number of seconds) and native images are lifted out of extra params into typed fields, so they reach Ollama without x-bf-passthrough-extra-params. A keep_alive that is neither a string nor a number is a local 400. Ollama's own errors, which arrive as {"error":"..."}, are passed through with their status and plain message.

Every case is [PREVIEW]: it needs a local Ollama (v0.35.0 or later) on localhost:11434 with tev1:0.8b-q8_0 pulled (`ollama pull tev1:0.8b-q8_0`, about 800 MB, text-only), which the harness cannot provision. Run with INCLUDE_PREVIEW=1. The shared profile's ollama key lists its models explicitly instead of *, so prefix-less requests are never routed to Ollama; tev1:bifrost-harness-missing is listed only so case 5 reaches Ollama and gets its 404.

Not covered here: input_image parts (moved into Ollama's images array, data URLs sent as raw base64) need a vision model such as clef-flash, so they are pinned by Go unit tests in core/providers/ollama only. The native /typesafe/v1/systemone route answers in Typesafe's shape without extra_fields, so case 6 pins routing and the native answer; keep_alive on the wire is pinned by cases 2 and 3. /v1/responses and /v1/chat/completions do not serve decisions.
